title: skills(objectstack-data): `rules/field-types.md` carries a ~1800-byte ASCII decision tree that duplicates the docs' mermaid page, in a file 17 tokens under its ceiling
body:
Observed by the os-dev flight on #16083 (PR #16187) while paying the token ratchet for two contract sentences, and handed to the seat to file because both dedup channels available to that flight were down (REST `/search/issues` 403, the one MCP `search_issues` refused by the rate limit). The seat's dedup: every open `domain:skills` card read for `decision tree` / `field-type-decision`; the only hit is #16083 itself, the card whose delivery surfaced this.

## The finding

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` carries a ~1800-byte ASCII "Field Type Decision Tree" block (around lines 147–216 at `5a30844272`) that re-lists every field type already given in the same file's tables. `content/docs/data-modeling/field-type-decision-tree.mdx` carries a mermaid version of the same tree, for the same reader. Two carriers of one tree, in a rules file whose token ceiling is 3584 and whose headroom after PR #16187 is **17 tokens**.

## Why it is a card and not a note

The ratchet made a two-sentence contract fix on #16083 pay with an unrelated deletion. The next author who needs one row in this file hits the same wall. Removing the duplicated tree frees roughly 450 tokens — real headroom, paid once, in the file's own density rather than in whichever unrelated sentence the next flight can spare.

The rules-only ruling for the skill corpus points the same way: a decision tree that only re-lists the tables is not a rule the client agent cannot get elsewhere in the same file.

## Acceptance

- The ASCII tree block is removed from `rules/field-types.md`; the tables it re-lists are untouched.
- If the file needs a pointer to the tree, it is one line naming the docs page, not a second rendering.
- `check-skills-token-ratchet` exit 0 with the new reading recorded; the per-file ceiling is NOT lowered in the same PR (a ceiling move is its own ruling).
- Governed surface (`skills/**`): draft PR, seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested, human merge.

Refs #16083, PR #16187.
